war_summary: War 139 is on day 101 with no winner yet and 32 victory towns required. The map remains heavily fragmented: many hexes are fully consolidated (Colonials hold Acrithia, Dead Lands, Drowned Vale; Wardens hold Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Viper Pit), while a handful of contested fronts dominate activity. The hottest regions over the last 24 hours are Oarbreaker (50 events, intense back-and-forth at Posterus and Partisan Island, 2 bases currently neutral), Endless Shore (41 events, Colonial push into Warden-held territory at The Old Jack Tar and The Overland), Clahstra (24 events, Colonial offensive against Warden bases like Transept and East Narthex), Stlican Shelf (21 events, Warden-held but under sustained Colonial assault at The Old Mourn), Mooring County (18 events, Borderlane hotspot), and Godcrofts (17 events, mixed ownership with recent fighting at Argosa and Saegio). Casualty rates are accelerating sharply in Callahan's Passage, Endless Shore, Marban Hollow, Olavis Wake, Onyx, and Callums Cape, indicating large ongoing battles even where capture events are sparse. Quiet rear regions show minimal activity and are unlikely to change hands in the next 24 hours.
